$comment: The claims register for this repository. Derived from the sealed register that governs gubernaut.com (astro-site/src/data/facts.json). Numbers change THERE first, then here. Enforced by tools/claims_check.py on every push and pull request.

banned_strings.$comment: Exact substrings. Case-sensitive. Each carries the reason it is banned, which is printed on failure so the message teaches rather than scolds.

$0.1670.why: The scored flagship value is $0.1669 (raw 0.16695). Never round up.
$0.1670.$comment_escape: CONTRIBUTING.md teaches the rule by naming the wrong value: "The flagship is $0.1669, not $0.1670." A document that states the correct value and rejects the wrong one in the same breath is doing this gate's job, not breaking it. Asserting the wrong value is still a failure.

0.1670.why: The scored flagship value is 0.1669. Never round up.
0.1670.$comment_escape: CONTRIBUTING.md teaches the rule by naming the wrong value: "The flagship is $0.1669, not $0.1670." A document that states the correct value and rejects the wrong one in the same breath is doing this gate's job, not breaking it. Asserting the wrong value is still a failure.

banned_strings.8.8%-21.8%: Does not reconcile with the scored table: 4.1, 5.2 and 7.4 all sit below 8.8. The published range is 4.1% to 20.2%.
banned_strings.10.5281/zenodo.21303519: Version DOI. Frozen-record only. Copy uses the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21303518.
banned_strings.10.5281/zenodo.21355030: Version DOI. Frozen-record only. Copy uses the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21303518.
banned_strings.openai.api_base =: Current OpenAI SDKs ignore this attribute silently, so a client configured that way goes upstream ungoverned with no error. The attribute is base_url. Naming api_base in a warning is fine; assigning it is not. LlamaIndex's own api_base= constructor argument is a different API and is allowed.

18080.why: Internal test-harness port. The proxy default is 8000 and :18080 never appears in public copy.
18080.$comment_scope: Prose only. bench/ and the example harnesses bind this port in working code, and renaming a functional port to satisfy a copy rule would be theatre. The rule is about what a reader is told, not what a test binds.

banned_strings.9/9: The validation result is 15 of 16 cells. 9/9 has never been a Gubernaut figure.
banned_strings.test the live runtime: The demo is a recorded replay. No call to action may imply live inference.

banned_words.$comment: Word-boundary matched, case-insensitive. negated_ok lists substrings that make an occurrence legitimate, which is how the required disclaimer 'Gubernaut is not injection-proof' survives the injection-proof rule. Without that, the gate fails the very sentence it exists to protect.

proven.why: Use 'measured' or 'verified'. Note: 'provenance' contains 'proven' and is fine, which is why this is word-boundary matched.

injection-proof.why: Injection resistance is claimed for the CONTROLLER only. The arbiter reads raw text by necessity.

AGI achieved.why: Not a claim this project makes.

required_together.$comment: The headline may never travel without its significance count and its null. This is the single most important rule in the file.
required_together.why: Any statement of 15/16 must also carry 13/16 at p<.05 and show the null cell. Never 'all', never rounded up.

social_proof_patterns.$comment: No reviews, testimonials, logos, user counts, download counts or star ratings exist for this project. None are ever fabricated, including as placeholder. These patterns catch the shapes.
social_proof_patterns.$comment_negation: The rule must not fail the sentence that states the rule. docs/LIMITS.md says 'No customer reviews, testimonials, logos, user counts...' and that is the disclaimer, not a violation of it.
social_proof_patterns.why: Rule 8. There is no exception path, including placeholder text.

dash_ban.$comment: Em-dash and en-dash are banned typography across Gubernaut surfaces. Use a period, comma, colon or middot. Ranges read '4.1% to 20.2%'. Scoped to the curated documentation surface: raw measured outputs under receipts/telemetry/ are data rather than copy, and vendored files are not ours to restyle.

scope.$comment: check_all runs the number, vocabulary, pairing and social-proof rules. curated_docs additionally runs the dash ban.
scope.$comment_changelog: CHANGELOG.md is excluded because it must be able to QUOTE the defect it fixed. A changelog that cannot name $0.1670 cannot record that $0.1670 was corrected. The same applies to the gate's own workflow and checker, which necessarily contain every banned string as data.
